_note: Stored response for --mock-copilot. This is NOT output from a Copilot call; it is served through the Copilot client interface and labelled strategy "mock". "file" is relative to the scanned directory.

response.description: Chunk the compute loop and the layout loop with cooperative yielding, keeping every operation, and ignore repeated clicks while the handler is yielding.
response.why_it_works: Yielding to the main thread between 1,000,000-iteration chunks and after every 10 layout operations lets the browser handle pending input and paint between slices, so the handler no longer runs as one long task. All iterations and layout reads/writes still run in the same order.
response.tradeoffs: The handler takes longer in total wall-clock time; clicks made while it is yielding are ignored; the counter text updates later.
